rules.title: Domain rules and policy
worker: State each proposed rule separately with its inputs, outcome, boundary cases, and supporting sources.
Keep accepted decisions distinct from proposals. Ask for a decision when the task requires one.
reviewer: Challenge ambiguous inputs, conflicting rules, missing boundary cases, and unsubstantiated claims of acceptance.
Explain each proposal in terms of its effect on the intended audience.

writing.title: Long-form writing
worker: Use the source pack to maintain terminology, argument structure, chronology, tone, and continuity.
Label new material and distinguish supported claims from interpretation.
reviewer: Check structure, continuity, clarity, voice, pacing, and whether each important claim is supported.

engineering-design.title: Engineering design
worker: State invariants, interfaces, failure cases, retries, concurrency, and recovery behavior.
Tie each requirement to its source and specify how it can be verified.
reviewer: Construct counterexamples for failure, retry, concurrency, and partial-state handling.
Check that proposed behavior and validation cover the accepted requirements.

code.title: Code changes
worker: Work within the pinned repository scope and explain each changed behavior.
Provide meaningful tests for changed behavior; the controller records actual test results.
reviewer: Check correctness, error paths, concurrency, security boundaries, and unintended changes.

owner-brief.title: Decision brief
worker: Write one clear question per decision with bounded options, consequences, and a recommendation.
Separate verified findings, assumptions, unresolved choices, and the next permitted action.
reviewer: Check that the options cover the meaningful alternatives and do not claim an unmade decision.

records.title: Records and filing
worker: Preserve record identity, content, authority, ownership, and status.
Keep a clear manifest of proposed file changes and verify the resulting bytes.
reviewer: Check exact content, target identity, scope, and preservation of unrelated material.
